title: Anna’s New Pals
description: A pretend tea with Anne and Diana.
script:
story 2
variable leaf = false hidden
scene anne-garden
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
I: Anna is at Green Gables.
Anne [happy]: I am Anne. This is Diana.
Diana [happy]: Come and play!
choice hello
option wave "Wave hello." -> wave
option bow "Take a bow." -> bow
label wave
react Anna wave
Anna [happy]: Hi! I am Anna.
react Anne wave
Anne [happy]: A new pal! Come in!
goto tea
label bow
react Anna bow
Anna [happy]: Hi! I am Anna.
react Anne bow
Anne [laughing]: A grand guest! Come in!
goto tea
label tea
Anne [excited]: Let us have a grand tea!
Diana [curious]: No cups! What can we use?
choice cup
option leaf "A leaf cup." -> leaf ; leaf = true
option shell "A shell cup." -> shell
label leaf
scene anne-leaf-tea
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
Anna [happy]: A leaf can be a cup!
Diana [happy]: It has a drip. Sip fast!
goto bugcheck
label shell
scene anne-shell-tea
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
Anna [happy]: A shell can be a cup!
Diana [laughing]: Tea by the sea! In a yard!
goto bugcheck
label bugcheck
if leaf == true -> leafbug else shellbug
label leafbug
scene anne-leaf-bug
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
goto bug
label shellbug
scene anne-shell-bug
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
goto bug
label bug
Anne [surprised]: A bug! A guest for tea!
choice bug
option tip "Tip it out." -> tip
option sip "Let it sip." -> sip
label tip
react Anna reach
Anna [happy]: Off you go, bug!
Diana [happy]: A soft leaf for you.
goto endcup
label sip
react Anne bow
Anne [laughing]: A sip for Sir Bug!
Diana [laughing]: He has six feet. No boots!
goto endcup
label endcup
if leaf == true -> leafend else shellend
label leafend
scene anne-leaf-tea
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
I: A leaf cup. A bun to split.
goto pals
label shellend
scene anne-shell-tea
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
I: A shell cup. A bun to split.
goto pals
label pals
Anna [happy]: Can we be pals?
Anne [happy]: Yes! You, Diana, and me!
Diana [happy]: Come back! We can have a picnic.
end
notice: A new make-believe visit to the world of Anne of Green Gables by L. M. Montgomery. These visits and words are newly written, not scenes or quotations from the book.

Anna.name: Anna
Anna.provenance: Storybook adaptation for Chunky Reader; shared polished SVG builder, not a likeness.

Anne.name: Anne
Anne.provenance: Original stylized book adaptation of Anne Shirley: red hair, imaginative and eager for friendship. Not based on an actor or screen adaptation.

Diana.name: Diana
Diana.provenance: Original stylized book adaptation of Diana Barry: dark hair, warm and practical. Not based on an actor or screen adaptation.
